title: Ravens hope Nnamdi Madubuike will start contact work in "next couple of weeks"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens hope Nnamdi Madubuike will start contact work in "next couple of weeks"
sources.description: Ravens defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike came off the physically unable to perform list early in training camp, but he has not returned to a full practice workload.
